summary: Teacher in Grand Rapids urges the FCC to continue and improve the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of reliable broadband in modern public education and the financial impact of reducing or ending E-Rate support.

claims.requested_action: continue and improve the E-Rate program
claims.argument: Decreasing or ending E-Rate would have direct and tangible impacts on schools' budgets and resources
claims.evidence_quote: Grand Rapids Public Schools has received $4.47 million in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $893,327 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
